proposals.evidence: DEDR1298: Kannada kalu/kallu, Telugu kallu and Gondi (Ma.) kalu denote stone, alongside Tamil kal. Pattapu kalu has a direct segmental and semantic comparison within this article. proposals.evidence: DEDR3559: Telugu tōlu and Kannada tōl(u) explicitly include leather as well as skin/hide, alongside Tamil tōl. Pattapu θōlu retains the long-vowel lateral stem with final u and an initial dental fricative; this is the attested material sense, not an inferred change from bark. Whole-article family membership is proposed; inheritance versus local transmission remains subject to review. proposals.evidence: DEDR4559: Tulu poḷtu denotes time, daylight and sun; Kannada portu and Telugu poddu/proddu likewise include sun. Pattapu pold̪u preserves a lateral-plus-dental cluster with a short vowel. Its plain l is not normalized to ḷ and the sun sense is explicit within this whole article. Whole-article family membership is proposed; inheritance versus local transmission remains subject to review. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
